hardware: Apple M4 Pro, 64 GiB; original 14-worker quest running concurrently
scope: Isolated experiment; the existing SRG(29,14,6,7) run is unchanged.
cache_policy: Exact FIFO, 250000 shared partial-class entries by default; solution keys never evicted.

memory_experiment.description: One million unique (row, 32-byte key) insertions, same interpreter, separate processes; peak RSS includes interpreter and NumPy. Synthetic cache experiment, not whole-quest memory.

limits: Single timing samples; no speedup established. CPU is master plus returned worker slice CPU; excludes manager and worker startup CPU.
Aggressive eviction repeated work. Long-quest runtime impact is unmeasured.
Resident memory may not fall immediately after eviction because of allocator reuse.
